subject: MAP: cross-functional evaluation asset transfer & timeline
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Eliza Park <eliza.park@lumisys.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: cross-functional evaluation asset transfer & timeline

Hi Eliza —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. As promised, I’m sending a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) for exchanging the evaluation assets (dataset samples, prompt pack, and testcases) and the target close timeline so your evaluation team can begin the technical validation. High-level items below; the attached PDF has the milestone table and acceptance criteria.

Proposed milestones (tentative):
- Week 0 (this week): NDA/DAA signature; Redwood provides read-only S3 link to a subset (10% seed)
- Week 1: Prompt pack + testcase sample delivered (prompt examples + expected outputs)
- Week 2–3: LumiSys runs tests and provides two reference prompts and a short regression report
- Week 4: Final discussion on results -> decision to proceed to pilot

Usage constraints we need to confirm:
- Assets are for evaluation only (no external redistribution or public posting)
- No re-selling or weaving into publicly-shipped training corpora
- Allowed: model inference, per-token logging for debugging, and short-term caching while the MAP is active
- Data retention: log artifacts will be retained for 90 days unless otherwise agreed

Attachments: redwood-eval-MAP-v1.pdf (MAP table + acceptance criteria), data-access-agreement_draft.docx (DAA draft). We can also provide a promptpack-sample-v2.zip if you want to sanity-check tokenization.

Next steps from our side once you confirm:
1) Sign DAA via DocuSign (link below)
2) We’ll provision temporary credentials (scoped, read-only) and notify engineering
3) Kick off value-check call and schedule a 30-minute demo for Thursday of Week 1

DocuSign (draft DAA): https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/XYZ-DAA-LUM-87
Shared drive (MAP materials): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_eval-MAP

Would you be able to confirm the high-level constraints and an initial signature by end of day Tuesday so we can hit the Week 0 milestone?

Thanks —
Michael Grant
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0186

Attachments: [redwood-eval-MAP-v1.pdf, data-access-agreement_draft.docx]

From: Eliza Park <eliza.park@lumisys.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Matt Chen <matt.chen@lumisys.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: cross-functional evaluation asset transfer & timeline

Michael —

Appreciate the clear plan. LumiSys is aligned on running a scoped evaluation but a few clarifying items before we sign the DAA: 

1) Embargo / internal sharing: we need a 45-day embargo from public disclosure and an allowance to share within LumiSys engineering and product (we will not share externally).
2) Tokenization & derived artifacts: is deriving embeddings from the dataset allowed for analysis? If allowed, we need assurance they won’t be used for model training outside of this MAP.
3) Escrow / deletion: after the 4-week window, can you provide confirmation that the dataset will be deleted from the temporary bucket and that audit logs will be exported to LumiSys?

Also: do you have a lightweight example runner (not full infra) to show how we should run the promptpack + testcase harness against your hosted endpoints? A short script or Docker image would help.

If we can get yes on the above points and the DAA looks OK, Matt and I can sign by Wednesday EOD.

Thanks,
Eliza Park
Head of Integrations, LumiSys
eliza.park@lumisys.ai

—
On Tue, Aug 24, 2026 at 09:15 AM Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com> wrote:
> (original message omitted)

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Eliza Park <eliza.park@lumisys.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Matt Chen <matt.chen@lumisys.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: cross-functional evaluation asset transfer & timeline

Hi Eliza / Matt —

Thanks for the questions — answers inline and next steps below. I’ve attached an updated MAP PDF and the promptpack sample (zip).

1) Embargo / internal sharing: Yes — 45-day embargo from public disclosure is acceptable. Internal sharing within LumiSys engineering & product is allowed. We’ll add the embargo clause to the DAA before sending for signature.

2) Tokenization & derived artifacts (embeddings): Allowed for analysis and feature engineering tied to this evaluation only. The DAA will explicitly prohibit use of derived embeddings for model training outside the evaluation scope.

3) Escrow / deletion & logs: Redwood will delete the temporary S3 bucket contents 7 calendar days after the final sign-off unless LumiSys requests escrow placement. We will export and provide access to audit logs (read-only) for the 90-day retention window in CSV.

Example runner: I’m including a small runner script and Dockerfile in promptpack-sample-v2.zip (instructions in README.md). It contains a simple harness that exercises 5 testcases against the hosted endpoint and generates the CSV required for our acceptance criteria.

Updated milestones (attached MAP):
- Day 0: DAA signed (DocuSign link) -> temp credentials provisioned
- Day 1: Prompt pack unpacked + runner smoke test (our side can walk your engineers through)
- Day 7–21: Full test run + two interim checkpoints (Week 1 sync, Week 3 results review)
- Day 28: Final acceptance call

DocuSign (updated DAA): https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/XYZ-DAA-LUM-87
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_eval-MAP

Attachments included: promptpack-sample-v2.zip, redwood-eval-MAP-v1.pdf (updated table), data-access-agreement_draft.docx (will be updated with embargo clause).

If this matches what you need, please say yes to the embargo and we’ll route the updated DAA for signature. We can provision credentials as soon as the signature completes.

Best,
Michael Grant
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: LumiSys MAP operational TODOs

Vanessa / Karthik —

LumiSys agreed to the embargo and core constraints; they’ll sign once we include the embargo clause in the DAA. Please action the following so we can hit provisioning the moment the signature hits: 

1) Vanessa: prep temp S3 bucket with lifecycle rule (auto-delete 7 days after sign-off) and scope credentials to read-only. Include SSE-KMS encryption with a separate key per-customer.
2) Karthik: enable audit logging (token-level) and configure automated CSV export for 90-day retention; ensure logs are accessible via the shared drive link in read-only mode for the customer.
3) Both: coordinate a 30-minute enablement call Thurs (Week 1) — propose Thursday 10:00am PT; I’ll invite LumiSys.

I’ll route the updated DAA via DocuSign once legal drops the embargo clause in. After signature, I’ll provision credentials and send the runner details.

Thanks —
Michael

(Internal note: attachments are already staged in the MAP folder — I’ll update the DAA with the embargo clause and route to legal this morning.)
